decision: verify-plan: non-test lines = additions+deletions of files not *_test.go and not */testdata/*; test-only or <50 -> root-check sonnet; >=50 -> full sonnet; non-test file under platform/{db,bus,money,concurrency} or modules/{trading,treasury,funding}, or a patch adding go func|sync.|atomic.|chan|select { -> full opus; then if the pick equals the owner model swap opus<->sonnet (fable banned by operator)

verdict pass|fail <pr> <sha> --kind --model --report [--key ~/.config/monaco/verifier.pem]: refuse sha != PR head, --kind weaker than verify-plan, owner unknown (fail closed), model == owner; report's first non-empty line -> description '<kind> by <model>: ...' (140 runes); JWT RS256 iat=now-60 exp=now+540 iss=verifier_app (matches app-jwt.sh), POST /app/installations/<id>/access_tokens -> token, POST /repos/R/statuses/<sha> context verify; PKCS1 or PKCS8 key; save .monaco/agents/verdicts/<pr>.json {pr, sha, patch_id, state, kind, model, description}
why: item 23 + root note on strict mode

decision: verdict carry <pr>: load verdict record; head unchanged -> no-op; else git fetch origin +refs/heads/<base>:refs/monaco/verdict/base refs/pull/<n>/head, patch-id --stable of diff merge-base(base, head)..head; equal to recorded -> repost same state on the new head with 'carried from <old7>: ...', update record; different -> refuse 'verify again'
why: strict up-to-date forces gt sync restacks; patch-id of base..head is stable across restack and retarget from lower branch to trunk

decision: Go 1.25 rejects RSA keys < 1024 bits; a _test.go with //go:debug rsa1024min=0 and a 256-bit key makes SignPKCS1v15 fail (message too long), which covers the sign error branch for 100% coverage
